name: Apasnyj Sovenok
source:
Playing as Zhenya, you try to survive in an alternate and exceptionally DANGEROUS version of the USSR. You are being targeted by rapists, and you must find a way to avoid the worst fate.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=728862212]Steam[/url]]
